findings.title: Materials' 70-point lens gap signals collapse
findings.body: Materials sits at the 16th percentile on forward earnings but the 87th on trailing, a 70-point chasm that implies 127 percent earnings growth. The market is pricing a near-total earnings reset, not a cyclical uptick.

findings.title: Health Care's rich multiple hinges on 84% growth
findings.body: Health Care's forward multiple is only 46 percent below trailing, yet the implied earnings growth is 84 percent. Analysts are underwriting a dramatic margin expansion that the trailing lens does not support.

findings.title: Utilities' cheapness is a value trap signal
findings.body: Utilities trades at the 10th percentile forward but the 1st percentile trailing, a rare inversion that implies just 12 percent growth. The market is paying a premium for stability, not for earnings power.
